en: The Section on the Training Rules (Sekhiyakaṇḍa)
The Training Rule on Traveling by a Byway.
At that time, the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now at that time, the group-of-six monks, walking off the path, were teaching the Dhamma to one walking on the path...
[as before] ... "The training is to be observed: 'I will not teach the Dhamma while walking off the path to one who is walking on the path and is not ill.
One walking off the path must not teach the Dhamma to one walking on the path who is not ill.

If, out of disrespect, one who is walking off the path gives a teaching to one who is on the path and not ill, there is an offense of wrong-doing. There is no offense if it is unintentional … [and so forth] …
the twelfth training rule is concluded.
